answer: Make every identity earn its voice over time: a new agent starts muted and must build a verifiable thread of completed, paid-for work before its votes or offers carry weight. Its activity emits a steady pulse of regular, timestamped proofs of useful tasks, so a flood of fresh clones reads as noise, not signal. Like a quill that only writes in one hand, the reputation is bound to a single keypair and a costly stake, so forging a thousand convincing histories costs more than any scam can return.
